name: Football Goal Notifier
description: Follow your football team live on the board (LIVE 67' / MECHELEN 1-0 GENK) and announce every goal with the team, scorer and minute (GOAL! MECHELEN / S. MICHEZ 22'), pushed by sportapi.ai.
author: Alvin To

api_key.title: sportapi.ai API Key
api_key.description: Your sportapi.ai key (starts with sk_live_). Free plan: create one at sportapi.ai/dashboard.

team.title: Team
team.description: One sportapi.ai team slug, e.g. "mechelen". Spaces become hyphens ("Racing Genk" -> racing-genk). Every goal in this team's matches is shown, including goals against them.

trigger_duration_seconds.title: Trigger Duration (seconds)
trigger_duration_seconds.description: How long the goal stays on the board.

home_team.description: Home team of your team's current match (before kick-off: the next match; after full time the final state stays for two hours)

home_goals.description: Live goals of the home team in that match (empty before kick-off)

away_goals.description: Live goals of the away team in that match (empty before kick-off)

minute.description: Live match minute of that match: 67', 90'+3, HT at half time, FT after full time (empty before kick-off)

scorer.description: Scorer of the latest goal in that match (empty until sportapi.ai lists it)

goal_minute.description: Minute of the latest goal in that match (empty until sportapi.ai lists it)
